svg.aria-label: Accurate 36 by 24 mat Cardon Weavehouse map with two square west and south outdoor strips
svg.text: DM MAP • 12 ROOMS • 2-SQUARE WEST + SOUTH EXTERIOR
MINI STARTS: B BUGBEAR • W WARRIOR • C CAPTAIN • J JAROOOD • G GARGOYLE • M MIMIC • L ELOWEN • E LARGE EARTH ELEMENTAL
DORM WORKER COUNTS ARE WRITTEN ON THE MAT: 4 / 4 / 5 / 4 • NO NUMBERED MARKERS.
DASHED FURNITURE = OPTIONAL DRAWN OUTLINES. LARGE 'E' BLOCK = 2×2 SQUARES. DOORS = OPENINGS, NOT REQUIRED PLASTIC PIECES.
